brief_gesture_description: The person stands facing the camera, extends both arms straight out to the sides like wings, and tilts the torso and arms side to side in a banking motion, mimicking an airplane in flight, before returning the arms to the sides.

iconicity.rationale: The outstretched arms and side-to-side banking motion directly resemble an airplane's wings and flight movement.

sensorimotor_imagery.rationale: The sweeping arm and torso motion evokes the physical sensation of flying or banking, though it is a stylized representation rather than a literal action.

motional_salience_gesture.rationale: The movement is large and dynamic, involving the full span of both arms and noticeable torso tilting.

emotional_salience_facial_expression.rationale: The facial expression remains neutral and focused throughout, conveying no distinct emotion.

gesture_complexity_fit.rationale: The simple, single-action gesture matches the concrete, easily visualized concept of an airplane.

cultural_familiarity.rationale: Mimicking an airplane with outstretched arms is a widely recognized and common gesture across cultures.

enactment_potential.rationale: The gesture is very easy to perform, requiring only extending the arms and tilting the body side to side.

possible_ambiguities: The gesture could also be interpreted as a bird flying or simply balancing.
